official_category_name: Approved Colleges of Nursing and Departments of Nursing
title: Nigeria Colleges of Nursing and Midwifery
description: Provisional institution-level reconstruction of Nigerian nursing and midwifery training institutions. It is not approved for publication until the NMCN PDF table rows and institution-level aggregation are reconciled.
institution_aggregation_policy: One record per independently recognized institution or separately approved training centre; nursing, midwifery, community and post-basic programmes under one centre are merged rather than exposed as separate public records.
source_hierarchy: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria
Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare

sources.organization: Nursing and Midwifery Council of Nigeria
sources.title: Updated List of Approved Colleges of Nursing and Departments of Nursing with their Accreditation Status, December 2025
sources.entry_semantics: The webpage reports 290 training institutions; the PDF contains numbered table rows and programme markers whose institution-level semantics remain unresolved
sources.approval_status_semantics: full and provisional are current approval statuses; withdrawn, denied and embargoed entries are not retained; the list is periodically reviewed
limitations: the webpage count does not equal the PDF numbered-row count
programme rows, institution rows, repeated row labels and wrapped table content require source-level reconciliation
the source does not provide SoftData state IDs or normalized ownership fields

sources.title: Approved Institutions
sources.purpose: Category-boundary cross-check; nursing institutions are not treated as health-technology colleges without separate evidence.

inclusion_rules: Current NMCN-approved nursing or midwifery training institution or separately approved centre
Teaching-hospital, military and specialist schools are included only where NMCN lists a distinct training institution
exclusion_rules: hospitals without a separately recognized school
withdrawn, denied, embargoed, proposed or under-accreditation entries
regulator_overlap_policy: NMCN approval is the primary inclusion authority. NBTE and health-sector sources resolve category and identity conflicts; absence from NBTE alone does not establish inactivity.
update_frequency: Review on each new NMCN approved-schools register or material regulatory update.
known_limitations: The NMCN webpage reports 290 training institutions, while the PDF contains 340 numbered table rows, 36 section headings, 494 programme markers and 329 unique printed row labels.
Institution-level aggregation is unresolved; the existing 176 public records are provisional and must not be treated as a final source-derived roster.
The preserved generated 290-entry reconciliation is a provisional working artifact and must not be treated as exact NMCN source evidence.
Ownership is reconciled from institution/government identity and requires review when an institution changes operator.
The public contract intentionally does not expose programme, accreditation or quota fields.
transitions_and_former_names: Programme aggregation, absorbed university departments, duplicate campuses and inactive entries remain provisional and require reconstruction from the PDF table structure.
rights: SoftData compilation, schema and metadata are CC BY 4.0. NMCN and NBTE publications retain their own rights. This pass adds only a static roster foundation; websites and logos are deferred.
